# Third-party notices

LumaGlyph is MIT licensed. It links against the crates below, and their
licences require their copyright notices to travel with the binaries. This
file is that notice, generated from the committed `Cargo.lock` so it always
matches what is actually shipped.

**435 packages**, every one of them permissively licensed. Regenerate
with `python3 scripts/third_party_notices.py` after a dependency change.

## Licence summary

| Licence | Packages |
| :--- | ---: |
| MIT | 384 |
| Apache-2.0 | 310 |
| Zlib | 19 |
| Unicode-3.0 | 18 |
| Unlicense | 6 |
| BSD-3-Clause | 5 |
| ISC | 4 |
| BSD-2-Clause | 2 |
| BSL-1.0 | 2 |
| CDLA-Permissive-2.0 | 2 |
| 0BSD | 1 |
| CC0-1.0 | 1 |
| MPL-2.0 | 1 |

Where a package offers a choice (`MIT OR Apache-2.0` and similar), LumaGlyph
takes MIT. No package imposes a copyleft obligation on the combined work.

Attribution-only note for the following, which offer a permissive option
alongside a copyleft one; the permissive option is the one used:

- `r-efi` 5.3.0 - `MIT OR Apache-2.0 OR LGPL-2.1-or-later`
- `r-efi` 6.0.0 - `MIT OR Apache-2.0 OR LGPL-2.1-or-later`
